Definition: from κόπρος (ordure; perhaps akin to G2875); manure:--dung(-hill).
BiblicalUsage: Kopria is dung, manure, the dunghill. Luke 14:35 says salt that has lost its savour is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill, but men cast it out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the dunghill is the end of useless salt: it cannot season the land and it cannot even enrich the dunghill, so it is cast out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
